about: A corner walkway of the crypt, 192×192 px: an L that leaves its west edge and turns north, so two rooms whose sockets do not face each other join (mirrored, it turns every way) (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13). Its floor a 64 px band of the causeway's stones laid across it, its sides a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall). Its ends run to the template's edge, where its two sockets are. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_corner_192_ground.tscn and its art from this.
